name: chatdaddy
description: Run your ChatDaddy inbox from a conversation — WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger, SMS and email. Send and search messages, manage contacts and tags, fire bots, set keyword replies and after-hours replies, run broadcasts, handle CRM tickets, and check why a channel stopped sending.

api_key.title: ChatDaddy API token
api_key.description: Create one in ChatDaddy → Developer → API Tokens. It starts with apit_ and decides which team Claude works in.
